headline: Blackstone (BX) Leads Kuwait Deal And AI Backing, Is The Upside Already Priced In?
summary: Blackstone (BX) is back in focus after leading a consortium in a $16,000 million lease and leaseback agreement with Kuwait Oil Company, alongside fresh backing of AI data center firm Firmus.
